The durable adapter harness operates as a formal verification layer, ensuring that all adapter implementations adhere to a defined shadow contract prior to engaging live systems. This establishes a dual regime where behavior is validated locally before committing to persistent storage. The conformance suite acts as a predicate logic engine over request sequences, verifying that each allowed request triggers a single quota increment and appends corresponding audit events. Deny events are similarly enforced, maintaining a binary state transition model. Failure modes include divergence from the shadow contract, incorrect quota accounting, or missing audit entries. These are mitigated by isolating the harness within a local context, preventing cascading failures into production environments.
